title: 5-Day Pattaya Gulf Coast Championship Links & Nightlife
description: Championship gulf coast golf and legendary nightlife. Play Siam Country Club (Old & Plantation Courses) and Jack Nicklaus’s Laem Chabang.

signatureTour.title: The Bangkok & Hua Hin Fairways
signatureTour.highlight: Upgrade to our comprehensive signature itinerary pairing Gulf of Thailand championship golf with Bangkok and Hua Hin.

inclusions.detail: Dedicated executive transport on standby for all golf connections and evening dining runs.
3 rounds: Siam Country Club (Old Course), Siam Country Club (Plantation), and Laem Chabang.
4 nights in Luxury Oceanfront Suites in Pattaya.
Dedicated caddie and golf cart included for each round.
Local recommendations and priority bookings for evening entertainment and dining.

itinerary.title: Transit from Bangkok to Pattaya & Coastal Suite Arrival
itinerary.subtitle: Gulf Coast Welcome
itinerary.imageCaption: Pattaya Gulf Coast Luxury Suites — Coastal Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Pattaya luxury oceanfront accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Bangkok and transfer via private executive van down the motorway to Pattaya. Check into your luxury oceanfront suite overlooking the Gulf of Thailand.

Enjoy sunset drinks by the pool before heading into town for an authentic Thai seafood feast.

itinerary.title: LPGA Thailand Venue: Siam Country Club (Old Course)
itinerary.subtitle: Round 1: World-Class LPGA Layout
itinerary.imageCaption: Siam Country Club Old Course — Schmidt-Curley (Redesign) (Par 72, 6,990 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Siam Country Club Old Course championship golf course Schmidt-Curley (Redesign) Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tee off at the world-renowned Old Course at Siam Country Club, longtime home of the Honda LPGA Thailand. Mature trees line rolling fairways leading to fast, undulating greens.

Enjoy lunch in the modern clubhouse before returning to Pattaya for an afternoon on the beach and an evening exploring the city's famous nightlife.

itinerary.title: Jack Nicklaus 27-Hole Layout at Laem Chabang
itinerary.subtitle: Round 2: Mountain, Lake & Valley 27 Holes
itinerary.imageCaption: Laem Chabang International Country Club — Jack Nicklaus (Par 72 (any 18 combination), 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Laem Chabang International Country Club championship golf course Jack Nicklaus Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Play Laem Chabang International Country Club, Jack Nicklaus’s scenic 27-hole championship complex set amidst rocky hills and lakes.

Conclude your round with beers on the patio before returning to Pattaya for a relaxed evening of seafood dining and entertainment.

itinerary.title: Schmidt-Curley Masterpiece: Siam Country Club (Plantation)
itinerary.subtitle: Round 3: Championship Finale
itinerary.imageCaption: Siam Country Club Old Course — Schmidt-Curley (Redesign) (Par 72, 6,990 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Siam Country Club Old Course championship golf course Schmidt-Curley (Redesign) Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tackle the 27-hole Plantation Course at Siam Country Club. Built on rolling pineapple hills with expansive waste bunkers and blind carries, it provides a thrilling strategic test.

Celebrate the final round with a tour-ending dinner at a premier rooftop restaurant overlooking Pattaya Bay.

itinerary.title: Morning Beach Leisure & Return to Bangkok Airport
itinerary.subtitle: Departure
itinerary.imageCaption: Gulf of Thailand Coastal View — VIP Return to Bangkok
itinerary.imageAlt: Gulf of Thailand Pattaya golf tour Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a leisurely breakfast and ocean swim before packing your clubs with assistance from your AGS host.

Your private executive vehicle returns you smoothly to Bangkok Suvarnabhumi Airport for your flight home.

faqs.question: Which courses at Siam Country Club are included?
faqs.answer: This package features the prestigious Old Course (LPGA venue) and the dramatic 27-hole Plantation Course.
